entries.title: 手持式护肤 Vlog 摄像机美学
entries.description: 这是一个为 Seedance 2.0 设计的详细分镜提示词，旨在生成一段具有手持迷你 …
entries.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bathroom vanity lighting. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy skincare vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bottle caps popping, cotton pad taps, water splashing, jar lids twisting, soft patting sounds.
SUBJECT: Young woman in her early 20s, hair wrapped in a soft headband, oversized robe, no makeup, relaxed expression. Calm, unwinding energy before bed.
SETTING: Small bathroom vanity area at night. Warm vanity lights, neatly arranged skincare bottles, mirror, soft quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (2s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the vanity shelf, sits down. "Time for my nighttime routine."
→ (2s, overhead shot) Pours cleanser onto palms, lathers gently.
→ (2s, close-up) Splashes face with water, pats dry with a towel.
→ (2s, handheld shot) Holds up a toner bottle, pours onto a cotton pad. "This one's been my favorite lately."
→ (2s, detail shot) Applies serum with gentle patting motions. No dialogue.
→ (2s, medium shot) Twists open a moisturizer jar, scoops a small amount. "Almost done."
→ (2s, macro shot) Applies lip balm, sets it back on the shelf.
→ (2s, propped shot) Brushes hair gently in front of the mirror.
→ (2s, warm ending shot) Looks at reflection, relaxed smile. "Ready for bed now."
→ (1.5s, final shot) Turns toward camera, reaches for the lens. "Goodnight." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural bathroom ambience bottle caps, water splashing, patting sounds should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual, almost a whisper.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine soft smiles, occasional pauses, imperfect framing, focus breathing, warm dim lighting. Should resemble a genuine personal skincare vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial production.

He looks straight into the camera with calm, confident intensity, then turns and launches into a clear, controlled forward somersault in slow motion as he leaves the cliff edge.

entries.title: 魔幻都市奇幻战斗动画
entries.description: 一个设定在雨中魔幻都市的史诗级高奇幻动漫战斗提示词。包含涉及多个魔法门和针对巨龙的射线…
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルック。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。舞台は雨に濡れた壮麗な魔法都市。映画的なハイファンタジー・アクションRPGとして描く。参照画像のキャラクターが、自身の前方に展開した主ゲートと、周囲に展開した複数の収束ゲートから連続ビームを放ち、巨大な黒竜を最後は全ゲート同時斉射でオーバーキル気味に撃破する。

【参照キャラクター固定】
ソース参照画像のキャラクターを参照し、同じ人物として維持する。参照画像はキャラクターの顔、目の形、虹彩色、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラーだけに使用する。参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミングは再現しない。表情、視線、口元、ポーズ、呼吸、自然な髪と衣装の揺れだけ変化してよい。特徴の混合、顔の平均化、衣装交換、別人化、クローン化、余計な人物の追加は禁止。装備品やアクセサリーは参照画像にあるものを保持し、勝手な増殖や別装備の追加をしない。攻撃は必ずキャラクター本人の掌前ゲート群から行い、腰の装備や小物から発射しない。
【キャラ適応ルール】
固定シーンの内容と戦闘展開は維持するが、背景の装飾、小物、魔法意匠、色味、発光色、空気感は参照キャラクターに合わせて調整する。都市の基礎構造は石造りの壮麗な魔法都市で固定しつつ、欄干意匠、魔法灯、水路、水晶柱、紋様、霧、反射色は参照キャラクターの世界観とカラーに寄せる。ビーム、ゲート、爆発、粒子、床反射も参照キャラクターの固有色を主軸に組み直す。色はキャラクターの魅力を最優先し、背景は一段暗く抑えて主役を埋もれさせない。

【3Dスタイル固定】
全編で繊細なセルルックを維持する。線は細く、顔・髪・衣装には明快な二段から三段のセルシェーディングと透明感のある中間影を入れる。瞳と髪には多層ハイライト。布、革、金属、宝石、濡れた石床、ガラス、水たまりを異なる反射と粗さで描き分ける。魔法だけは高輝度のグラフィックアニメVFX、体積光、加算発光、屈折波、方向性モーションブラーを用いる。太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、汎用的な3D顔、低密度背景、半写実、画風混合にしない。
【主人公と敵の固定】
主人公は画面左、敵は画面右。主人公は両脚を広げて膝を曲げ、後脚へ重心を残し、片方の掌を竜の胸へ向けて開く。もう片方の手はその腕や手首を支えてよい。掌、手首、肘、肩の接続を読ませ、ゲートで腕全体を隠しすぎない。反動は手首、肩、腰、支持脚へ連続して返り、髪、衣装、装飾が時間差で後方へなびく。敵は右側の巨大な黒い四足翼竜一体のみ。主人公の約四倍の高さ。頭は一つ、角は二本、目は二つ、脚は四本、翼は左右一対、尻尾は一本。着弾点は胸中央で固定。余分な頭、脚、翼、尻尾を作らない。

【舞台とカメラ】
舞台は雨上がりの巨大な魔法都市にある、空中へ張り出した広い石造りの魔法大通り。濡れた石板、浅い水たまり、古い亀裂、魔導金属の欄干、周囲の魔法塔、尖塔、アーチ橋、空中回廊、浮遊小塔、巨大結晶柱、魔力灯、発光水路、低い霧を配置する。これらの意匠と発光色は参照キャラクターに合わせて調整する。主人公は左、黒竜は右を維持し、主ゲート中心、各副ゲート、ビーム軸、黒竜の胸が同じ攻撃線へ収束する。カメラは顔が読める緩い近距離弧移動から始まり、ゲートの円弧がレンズを覆う遮蔽ワイプで低い後方三分の四ワイドへ移る。ビームに沿った横移動では欄干、雨粒、床紋様、水たまり反射、浮遊灯を異なる速度で流し、着弾圧で短く押し戻され、煙が開く時だけ静かに寄る。無目的な周回やランダム手ぶれにしない。
【攻撃展開】
開始時、主人公の掌前に主ゲートが形成される。二層から四層の不完全な同心円ゲートで、各リングは前後へ離れ、異なる速度で逆回転する。短い目盛り、放射線、電光が発射軸へ集まり、掌の光が三度脈動し、三度目でリングが圧縮される。同時に主人公の周囲にも複数の副ゲートが次々と発生する。位置は右肩上、左上後方、前方上空、脇前方、背後上空など、深度差を持って主人公を囲むように配置する。数は多いが整理され、前景・中景・後景へ分かれる。顔と両目は常に読めるよう残し、リングで完全に隠さない。

最初の攻撃では主ゲートから太い高出力ビームを放つ。コア、外殻、中間層、縁の色は参照キャラクターの固有色で構成し、細い棒状にしない。直後、周囲の副ゲートが時間差で順番に発射し、黒竜の胸中央へ連続着弾する。各ビームは十分に太く、雨、霧、水滴を外側へ押し分ける。黒竜の胸鱗は押し込まれ、前爪が濡れた石床を削り、翼膜、首、尻尾へ衝撃が遅れて伝わる。床には主人公の固有色に対応した太い反射帯が走る。
【オーバーキルと撃破】
連続照射の後、全ゲートが最大出力へ再圧縮される。主人公は左下で踏ん張ったまま掌を固定し、周囲の全副ゲートも同じ着弾点へ狙いを合わせる。主ゲートを含む全ゲートが同一フレームで一斉斉射し、複数の極太ビームが黒竜の胸中央へ集中する。各ビームは太さ、輝度、軸を落とさず持続し、内部に圧縮波が走る。最後の圧縮波が胸へ到達した同一フレームで、全ビームを発射口から着弾点まで完全に消す。細い残光を残さない。その瞬間、胸中央に白熱核が発生し、局所的な半球状衝撃ドームが一度だけ膨張して裂ける。そこから参照キャラクターの固有色を主軸にした巨大な炎状魔力爆発が上方と左右へ立体的に噴き上がる。鋭い炎の先端、太い体積光、透明な屈折波、細い電光、外向きの速度線を深度差付きで展開する。濡れた床には発光亀裂が走り、水、蒸気、黒い鱗片、石片が外向きへ吹き飛ぶ。

直後、灰煙と黒い鱗片が前景へ重なり、黒竜の全身を完全に隠す。煙の中央が裂けると、黒竜は胸の着弾点をこちらへ向けて跪いている。胸中央から主人公の固有色に対応した魔力亀裂が全身へ走り、翼端と尾先から黒い鱗が灰へほどけ、微細な発光粒子へ変わる。翼膜、翼骨、尻尾、四肢、胴、首、頭へ連続して崩壊し、最後に胸の魔力核、角、両目の光が粒子へ砕け、肉体、影、床の反射まで完全に消える。死体を残さない。終端は戦闘結果の一枚絵。前景左に主人公、後景右には黒竜がいた空の濡れた路面と、消えかける灰と発光粒子だけを残す。主人公は警戒を保ったまま掌をわずかに下げ、呼吸とともに髪と衣装が落ち着く。最後の粒子が上昇し、黒竜の影と反射が完全に消えた瞬間に切る。
【重大な破綻防止】
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、UIなし。ビームの細線化、短時間化、途中減衰、早すぎる爆発、ビームと爆発の長い同時表示、消え残るレーザーなし。平面的で左右対称な花形爆発、同じ大きさの丸煙、全画面白飛びなし。黒竜を煙が消える前に見せない。竜の立ち直り、瞬間消失、透明化、死体残留、切断された翼や尻尾、複数尻尾なし。

entries.title: 电影级动漫魔法剑战
entries.description: 一个高细节的电影级动画提示词，用于高强度的 3D 卡通/赛璐珞风格动作 RPG 剑术对…
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックによる映画的アクションRPGの高速剣戟。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。8秒の短尺で、浮遊刀の猛攻、防御、回避、反力、包囲、最大衝突を高密度に連結する。

【参照画像と人物固定】
@1は一人目、キャラクターAの参照画像。
@2は二人目、キャラクターBの参照画像。
ソース参照画像のキャラクターを参照し、それぞれ同じ人物として維持する。参照画像はキャラクターの顔、目の形、虹彩色、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラー、武器意匠だけに使用する。参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミング、文字、分割レイアウトは再現しない。
二人は全編でそれぞれsame person、same character identity。表情、視線、口元、姿勢、呼吸、自然な髪と衣装の揺れだけ変化してよい。特徴混合、顔の平均化、髪色交換、衣装交換、武器交換、体格変化、別人化、クローン化、分身、追加人物を発生させない。

【世界観と舞台の自動調整】
戦闘内容、位置関係、動作、力関係、刀数、カメラ構造は固定する。背景、小物、建築様式、床材、天候、照明、色味、粒子、環境エフェクトのみ、@1と@2のキャラクターデザインに合わせて再設計する。

二人の衣装、装飾、武器、素材、模様、固有色、モチーフから、両者が自然に存在できる一つの映画的戦闘舞台を新規構築する。学園都市、宮殿、神殿、庭園、幻想都市、工業施設、近未来空間などから最適な舞台を選ぶ。ただし参照画像の背景は直接コピーしない。

床には反射、水滴、砂塵、雪、花弁、火の粉、魔力粒子など、世界観に適した接触表現を配置する。欄干、柱、ガラス、樹木、機械構造、魔法装置、発光線などの小物は舞台に適したものだけを使う。背景は人物より一段暗くし、顔、シルエット、刀の軌道を明瞭にする。
キャラクターAの固有色を攻撃側のキーライト、浮遊刀のオーラ、斬撃残光へ使用する。キャラクターBの固有色を防御光、反撃残光、補助光へ使用する。両者の色は混ぜず、明確に識別できる状態を保つ。

【画風固定】
細く繊細な色付き輪郭線。顔、髪、衣装、武器に明快な二段から三段のセルシェーディングと透明感のある中間影。瞳は多層ハイライト、髪は繊細な束感、衣装は刺繍、レース、装甲、鎖、宝石、金具など、参照画像に存在するディテールを高密度に描く。

布、革、金属、宝石、ガラス、床を異なる反射率と粗さで描き分ける。太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、簡略TVアニメ、汎用3D美少女顔、プラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、実写、くすんだ色、画風混合にしない。参照画像の画風はコピーせず、高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックへ統一する。

【武器固定】
キャラクターAは手持ち刀一本と、身体の周囲に浮かぶ四本の浮遊刀を使用する。浮遊刀はAの上、下、左、右を囲むように配置する。キャラクターBは手持ち刀一本を使用する。映像全体の刀は合計六本に固定する。

参照画像の武器が刀ではない場合も、その武器の色、素材、意匠、装飾、モチーフを継承した刀へ再設計する。
浮遊刀は刀身、鍔、柄が接続された完全な一本の刀。攻撃時のみ明確な飛翔軌道で動き、接触または回避後はAの周囲へ戻る。増殖、消失、融合、変形、余分な刀の追加を行わない。切っ先や刀身だけを独立回転させない。手持ち刀は柄だけを握り、刀身を手で掴まない。

【浮遊刀エフェクト】
四本の浮遊刀はキャラクターAの固有色を中心とした薄い炎状、霧状、粒子状、電光状のオーラを纏う。表現形式はAの世界観に合わせるが、必ず刀身へ密着させる。移動方向へ短い尾を引き、巨大な独立レーザーや別個の光線にしない。斬撃残光は刀の掃引面に密着した湾曲残光として発生する。

【力関係】
キャラクターAは冷静に主導権を握る格上。四本の浮遊刀を時間差で操りながら、自身も手持ち刀で前進する。キャラクターBは高い剣技で猛攻を弾き、避け、受け流し、反撃を試みるが、攻撃方向が連続して変化するため徐々に押される。Aだけが前進し、Bだけが後退する非対称な移動を維持する。
【カメラ】
固定横視点ではなく、浮遊刀越しの斜め低角度、Bの肩越し、接触点の近距離、接触点を軸にした約60度の回り込み、最終衝突へ迫る斜め低空カメラを使用する。浮遊刀のレンズ前通過、環境粒子、床から跳ねる飛沫、刀光を短い遮蔽ワイプに使う。カメラと背景が回り、人物を無意味に回転させない。

【8秒の動作構成】
Cut 1：
四本の浮遊刀がAの上下左右に静止した状態から開始。カメラは二本の浮遊刀の間を抜ける斜め低角度で、Aの顔、上半身、装飾、手持ち刀を見せる。Aは静かに前進し、視線だけでBを捉える。直後、右上の浮遊刀が加速し、Bの左肩口へ斜めに飛ぶ。

Cut 2：
Bの肩越し。Bは両手の刀で最初の浮遊刀を刀身中央同士の単一接触点で外側へ弾く。金属火花、両者の固有色の魔力火花、環境粒子、反力が発生する。弾かれた刀は弧を描いてAの周囲へ戻る。続いて左下の二本目が床すれすれを走り、Bは低く沈んで紙一重で回避。左上の三本目が斜め上から降下し、Bは刀を返して受け流す。

Cut 3：
環境粒子の遮蔽からAを斜め前方で映す。Aは止まらず踏み込み、手持ち刀で右下から左上へ斬り上げる。Bは後退しながら受け止める。二本の手持ち刀が一点で接触した瞬間、右下の浮遊刀がBの側面から侵入する。Bは肩を引いて避けるが、姿勢が横へ流れる。Aは接触を滑らせて解除し、さらに懐へ入る。
Cut 4：
接触点を中心にカメラが約60度回り込む。Bは反力を利用して返し斬りを放つが、Aの浮遊刀一本が側面から接触し、Bの刀を上へ逸らす。Aは手持ち刀を左上から右下へ振り下ろす。Bは急いで受け止めるが、足元が滑り後方へ押される。残る三本の浮遊刀がBの左右と上方へ散開し、退路を狭める包囲構図を作る。

Cut 5：
斜め低空カメラ。左手前に前進するA、右奥に押し込まれるB。Bは最後の反撃として踏み込む。Aも前進を止めず、左下から右上へ上昇斬りを放つ。二本の手持ち刀が中央の単一接触点で明瞭なX字を形成する。浮遊刀一本がBの刀身へ側面から追加圧力を加え、残る三本は周囲で次の斬撃姿勢を取る。
Aの攻撃色とBの防御色が別々に立ち上がり、中心の狭い白熱核の外側に巨大な二色のX字色面を形成する。放射状の衝撃波、環境粒子、蒸気、火花が広がる。Bの後ろ足が滑り、膝が沈み、両腕と肩の防御線が崩れ始める。Aは低い重心のまま前へ力を通す。X字の発光が最大まで拡大し、Bの防御崩壊が始まった瞬間に即カット。戦闘継続。

【重大NG】
固定横の格闘ゲーム視点、左右対称の全身構図、鏡写しの同時ダッシュ、長い助走、長い鍔迫り合い、無意味な連続回転は禁止。刀はAの手持ち一本＋浮遊四本、Bの一本、合計六本を固定。浮遊刀の増殖、消失、融合、変形、身体への貫通、切っ先だけの独立回転は禁止。手で刀身を握らない。独立レーザー、第三の光線、二色融合、全画面白飛びなし。追加人物、文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、UI、音響生成なし。

entries.title: 写实风格无线耳机广告
entries.description: 一份详细的 15 秒写实风格无线耳机广告分镜提示词，场景设定为城市中的女性设计师。
entries.prompt:
生成 15 秒、9:16、超写实的原创真无线耳机广告。克制、安静、城市呼吸感。

主角：28 岁东亚女性平面设计师，黑色短发、自然肤色，炭灰衬衫 + 白背心 + 深色直筒裤 + 低帮帆布鞋。全片脸、发型、服装、身材必须一致。

产品：雾面深灰耳机，极细暖铜金属边；扁平圆角深灰磨砂充电盒，内侧琥珀色反光。无品牌、Logo、文字、UI。

0–3 秒：清晨冷蓝室内，固定中景看向靠窗工作桌；素描本、水杯、打开的耳机盒。她戴上一只耳机，拿起素描本离开。
3–6 秒：地下通道低机位跟拍脚步，人流从两侧掠过；她轻触耳机一次，短推近耳侧，城市保持真实、模糊、流动。
6–9 秒：暖灰印刷工作室，裁切纸张、色卡、金属尺、台灯；先拍手、纸张和耳机，再缓移至侧脸。耳机自然可见，不要硬特写。

9–12 秒：雨后公交车，窗外霓虹被雨水拉成长条。通过玻璃反射拍侧脸；她把一只耳机放回盒内，另一只留在耳中。
12–15 秒：深夜工作桌，只留小台灯。她放回另一只耳机，合上充电盒；镜头后拉，闭合耳机盒置于素描本前景，窗外夜色虚化。

声音：车辆、脚步、地铁回响、纸张、裁纸器、雨滴、公交低鸣、盒盖轻响。不要背景音乐、旁白、字幕、Logo、水印、可读文字；避免耳机变形或重复、人物或服装漂移、多余手指、手部畸形、突兀转场。

entries.title: 史诗冰雪奇幻：泰坦觉醒
entries.description: 一个宏大的电影级提示词，描绘了冰雪泰坦在冰封山谷中挣脱冰川束缚的震撼场景。
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
RIMEBORN. In a frozen valley of an original ice-fantasy world, a mountain-sized titan of layered ice and stone tears itself free from a millennia-old glacier as an army of armored wardens scrambles across the frozen field below, a war-horn ripping across the plain. Timed multishot, five hard cuts across 10 seconds, one shared valley, one titan, one army throughout.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@titan: mountain-sized ice-and-stone colossus, humanoid silhouette, body built of fractured basalt slabs seamed by ancient blue ice, ice-plated shoulders and back crusted a meter thick with hoarfrost, joints and eye-sockets and rib-seams glowing with pale-cyan runes carved deep into the stone. Original design. 100% matches the reference.
@wardens: armored foot-soldiers in weathered dark steel plate over black padded gambesons, snow-crusted fur mantles at the shoulders, long spears and rimed shields, no faction crest or logo. Original design. 100% matches the reference.
@warhorn: a curled black bone horn as long as a warden is tall, bound in leather and iron rings, held at chest height by a single horn-bearer.
STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a fixed keyframe; model extends the world freely, never reproduced 1:1.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: fractured glacier surface, blue-ice slabs shot through with dark grit, powder snow drifting sideways at 20 km/h. Midground: the wardens crossing the field 200 meters below the titan, tiny against the scale, spears and shields catching the flat light. Background: the glacier wall itself, kilometers of vertical ice cracking apart around the emerging titan, snow plumes rising several hundred meters into a leaden overcast sky. Camera moves along a chest-height and then rising line down the valley floor, always with the titan camera-right or dead-center.

SCALE LOCK
@titan stands as tall as roughly two hundred wardens stacked head to toe. A single warden reads as a fingernail against the titan's shin in the establishing wide. Ice slabs shearing off the titan's shoulder each read as wide as ten wardens laid head to toe. The size gap holds identical every frame.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Non-empty opening frame: @titan is already mid-tear-out, right arm already ripping free from the glacier wall with a sheet of ice already fracturing off the shoulder, @wardens already running across the ice below, the horn-bearer already lifting @warhorn. Nothing is frozen, everything is already in motion. Rule of thirds: the titan held on the right two-thirds vertical, the horizon line on the lower third, wardens on the lower left third.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, exactly FOUR HARD CUTS at 2.5s, 4.5s, 6.5s, 8.0s. The camera does not cut on its own; cuts only at the specified points.
0.0s to 2.5s — CUT 1, real time
2.5s HARD CUT
2.5s to 4.5s — CUT 2, real time
4.5s HARD CUT
4.5s to 6.5s — CUT 3, real time
6.5s HARD CUT
6.5s to 8.0s — CUT 4, real time
8.0s HARD CUT
8.0s to 10.0s — CUT 5, real time

OPTICS
CUT 1: EWS at 84° FOV sweeping wide establishing the full valley and titan. CUT 2: MS at 29° FOV portrait compression on the titan's shoulder as ice sheets shear off. CUT 3: WS at 63° FOV low across the crevasse rim as wardens dive clear. CUT 4: MCU at 29° FOV on the horn-bearer, horn lifted to lips. CUT 5: EWS at 107° FOV super-wide rectilinear on the full glacier splintering with runes flaring. Rectilinear with anamorphic optical flares, 180° shutter motion blur, prime-lens character, no drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld throughout with 3 to 5 cm of shake, shake spiking hard on every cracking impact from the titan. CUT 1: chest-height sweep at 15 km/h left-to-right across the valley floor, catching the full scale. CUT 2: whip-in and hold at 20 meters from the shoulder, camera flinching as slabs shear past. CUT 3: low-angle at knee-height on the crevasse edge, wardens diving over the lens. CUT 4: tight on the horn-bearer, camera pressing in 30 cm as the horn sounds. CUT 5: pulled back and rising crane to 80 meters above the valley floor, wide vantage, gimbal weighty. Wide tonal latitude, soft highlight roll-off, whites hold detail without clipping.

ACTION
CUT 1 — Subject: @titan tears its right arm and shoulder free from the glacier wall, basalt-and-ice mass grinding against ice, a wall of powder snow erupting behind it hundreds of meters high; @wardens sprint across the frozen field in a scattered line, spears and shields flashing. Camera: sweeping wide dolly along the valley floor at 15 km/h, shake spiking as the titan's arm lands its first step-load.
CUT 2 — Subject: massive sheets of blue ice shear off @titan's shoulder and back, tumbling in slabs the size of buildings, hoarfrost crust exploding into powder mid-fall, runes along the shoulder flaring pale-cyan as the plates shed. Camera: whip-in, holds on the shoulder as three slabs fall past the frame, shake hard.
CUT 3 — Subject: @wardens dive clear as a crevasse collapses under them, two soldiers throwing themselves flat and rolling as the ice gives way, spears skittering across the surface, powder snow plumes rising vertical. Camera: low-angle handheld, wardens leaping over the lens, shake violent on the collapse.
CUT 4 — Subject: the horn-bearer lifts @warhorn to their lips and blows one long note, chest visibly expanding, breath fogging in the cold, the sound carrying across the field as other wardens turn their heads toward it. Camera: tight handheld, presses in 30 cm as the note sounds.
CUT 5 — Subject: @titan pulls its full torso free of the glacier wall, the whole glacier splintering apart around it in a cascade of fracturing ice, runes along both arms and the ribcage flaring bright cyan at once, snow erupting in vast vertical plumes across the entire valley. Camera: pulled back to a vast super-wide, rising crane, catching the primordial scale in one held frame, HARD CUT at 10.0s.

PERFORMANCE
@titan performs with geological slowness and crushing weight — every movement loaded before it lands, joints grinding stone on stone, no theatrical flourish. @wardens read as terrified working soldiers, not heroes: eyes wide, mouths open, breath fogging hard, one soldier stumbling and being pulled up by another mid-cut. The horn-bearer reads as steady and old, jaw set, eyes tracking the titan. Pore-level realism on the horn-bearer's face: vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush from the cold, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise. Restrained and human across the army, never cartoonish. Top-tier cinematic restraint.

PHYSICS
Mass and inertia carry through every movement of @titan — the arm loads before it tears free and drags the whole torso with it. Ice slabs fall with real weight, not lightweight fragments; they shatter on impact with the glacier floor, not float. Snow plumes obey the crosswind vector at 20 km/h and shear leftward across the valley. Wardens have real body weight — diving bodies land hard, not softly, and slide on the ice with correct friction. The horn's vibration reads faintly in loose snow at the horn-bearer's feet. Nothing floats. Correct contact shadows read clearly where titan meets glacier and warden meets ice.

LIGHTING
WB locked 6500K cold overcast daylight, flat and even, sun fully occluded by leaden cloud. Key is a broad diffuse top-light with no direct sun. The only emitted light in the world is the pale-cyan 5500K rune glow along @titan's joints, eye-sockets, and rib-seams, which spills onto the surrounding hoarfrost and briefly reflects in the wardens' plate on close cuts. Camera on the shadow side of the titan across all wide cuts. Faint atmospheric haze at 30% at the glacier wall, thickening into the snow plumes.

COLOR GRADE
Stark white in the snow and powder, frozen blue in the deep ice seams, near-black in the fractured basalt of the titan's core, leaden grey in the sky; every cold tone comes from real material and light bounce, not a filter. Rune cyan lives only in the carved channels — joints, eye-sockets, ribcage seams — and its spill onto immediate hoarfrost. Warden plate reads as dark weathered steel with cold reflections. Blacks stay open with detail in the basalt, highlights roll off in the snow. Color tied to source and surface, not a flat list.

WARDROBE
@wardens wear weathered dark steel plate over black padded gambesons, snow-crusted fur mantles at the shoulders, iron-rimmed shields, cold-numbed hands in gloves. Fur crusted with ice at the seams. No faction crest, no logo. The horn-bearer wears the same but with a heavier fur mantle and a leather baldric holding @warhorn.

AUDIO
NO MUSIC. SFX ONLY — diegetic sound and live audio throughout. No score, no soundtrack, no background music of any kind. CUT 1: sub-bass glacier groaning, ice cracking in long tearing sheets, wardens' plate rattling and boots crunching on ice, wind at 20 km/h. CUT 2: massive stone-on-ice grind, slabs shattering as they hit the glacier floor, rune flare with a low harmonic hum. CUT 3: sharp ice crack, powder snow whumphs, wardens' shouts and grunts, one spear clattering on ice. CUT 4: the horn's long low note, one held bass tone spreading across the valley, warden breath fogging audibly. CUT 5: a full-body glacier splintering roar, layered ice-shear, one titanic bass groan from @titan itself. No dialogue, no subtitles.

STYLE
8K photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Naturalistic master cinematography, fine film grain, 35mm film character, crushing primordial-scale epic look, hyperdetailed ice, snow, hoarfrost, basalt, weathered steel.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
10 seconds, five cuts, 16:9, 8K ultra-high-definition, 24 fps, real-time throughout, anamorphic flare character on rune spill.

POSITIVE LOCKS
One shared valley, one @titan, same @wardens and @warhorn across all five cuts, identical every frame, no morphing, no drift. @titan stays mountain-sized against the wardens throughout — the scale relationship holds exactly: 200 wardens tall in every wide, one warden a fingernail against the shin. Runes stay pale cyan and stay carved into the stone, they do not migrate. Handheld shake spikes on every titan movement and every ice collapse, never smooths out. Camera stays third-person outside the army throughout the 10 seconds. Warden eyes stay natural — no eye glow; the only emitted light in the world is @titan's runes. Contact shadows read clearly where titan meets glacier and warden meets ice. Ice slabs fall with mass, never floating. Snow travels on one consistent wind vector. Clean frame throughout — no logos, no UI, no text overlays, no subtitles, no watermark, no dragons or unrelated creatures in shot.

Top header: THE MILKSHAKE MAKER TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS 8 SHOTS · THICK · CREAMY · CLASSIC DINER Legend icons: ACTION, HEAT, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT Same Pixar-style young male soda jerk throughout — warm friendly smile, white paper hat, red bow tie, classic American diner setting, chrome counter, red vinyl stools, checkered floor, neon sign glowing in the window, warm afternoon light. 8 panels: Panel 1 — THE OPENER: Wide action shot. Soda jerk tosses the metal blender cup up with one hand and locks it firmly onto the mixer base with a confident flick of his wrist — motion frozen mid-action, his focused smile visible. Chrome counter, red vinyl stools and checkered floor visible around him. Different from the standing-and-presenting energy — this is action from frame one. Panel 2 — THE SCOOP: Close-up. Ice cream scoop digging deep into a tub of creamy vanilla ice cream — thick generous scoops lifted out and dropped into the metal blender cup one after another. Panel 3 — THE MILK: Wide medium with him fully visible. Soda jerk tilts a glass milk bottle, pouring a thick steady stream into the blender cup over the ice cream — his face focused, posture leaning slightly forward. Character back in frame. Panel 4 — THE BLEND: Dramatic close-up. Blender spinning at full speed — the milkshake swirling and churning vigorously inside the cup, a visible vortex forming, becoming completely smooth and impossibly thick. Panel 5 — THE POUR: Overhead locked shot looking straight down into the tall glass as the thick milkshake pours in from above — swirling and settling as it fills, the surface forming a slow spiral. Completely different angle from any other panel in the series. Panel 6 — THE CREAM: Wide medium with him fully visible. Soda jerk piping whipped cream in a tall perfect swirl on top of the milkshake — his hand steady and precise, face focused with concentration, the cream building higher with each pass. Panel 7 — THE CHERRY: Close-up dramatic, low side angle. A single bright red cherry falling from above into frame, about to land on the whipped cream peak — captured mid-fall at a completely different angle from the cream panel before it. Panel 8 — THE SIP: Wide warm shot, completely different setting energy from panel 1. Customer seated at the counter wraps both hands around the tall glass, leans in and takes the first sip through the straw — eyes closing in pure satisfaction, whipped cream on their nose. Soda jerk watching proudly from behind the counter, arms crossed, warm smile. Diner neon glowing softly behind them both. Footer: VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. First scoop to first sip. CAMERA TIPS: wide action shot for the opener, close-up for the scoop, wide medium with him visible for the milk pour, dramatic close-up for the blend, overhead locked for the pour, wide medium with him visible for the whipped cream, close-up low side angle for the cherry, wide warm for the first sip LIGHT & STYLE: warm diner afternoon light, creamy vanilla white, vivid red cherry, pure white whipped cream, chrome counter shine, checkered floor, Pixar vivid warm colors throughout SODA JERK NOTES: one soda jerk, one glass, one perfect milkshake. entries.prompt:
KAEL DRAYN @[Image] — "Frontier Justice" | Action Sequence. 15-second montage, hyper-kinetic rhythmic editing, variable frame
rates.

Art Direction & Vibe: Premium key art. Unified style: high-end gritty sci-fi
anime render, sharp graphic linework, cinematic spatial lighting. Setting:
lawless outer-rim outpost, dusty streets, rusted corrugated metal, harsh desert
sun.

Color Discipline: Suppressed palette: sun-bleached beige, dry ochre, rusted
iron, muted olive. Accents: his terra-cotta skin/markings, searing crimson enemy
blaster bolts, and the blinding neon-green of his plasma sword. High contrast;
the plasma blade casts stark green rim-light on kicking dust. Atmosphere:
blowing sand, heat distortion, flying sparks, kinetic motion blur.

The Character: Locked design (match reference): KAEL DRAYN, Outer Rim Sentinel.
Patterned alien head-tails, dark facial markings, calm focused eyes. Earth-toned
tactical gear, draped olive cowl, utility belts, combat boots. Wields a
mechanical hilt emitting a neon-green plasma blade. Demeanor: disciplined,
precise, unshakeable — zero wasted movement amidst chaos.

Shot Design: Rotate combat grammar. Macros (thumb igniting hilt, green blade
melting a crimson blaster bolt, tactical boot pivoting in sand) to wide
acrobatic leaping strikes. Hard diagonals, dirty over-the-shoulder perspectives,
dynamic low-angle hero framing. Lighting: blistering harsh daylight, intense
neon-green ambient glow during strikes. 3 environmental combat frames: a
scorching blast-mark on an adobe wall, sliced metal debris falling, wind
sweeping dust over footprints.

Story Arc: Open on tense stillness. Omens: shifting shadows, a mercenary's
weapon clicking. Introduce in defense: mechanical hilt snaps up, blade ignites,
tight macro framing of rapid blaster deflection. Escalate through the
counter-attack: Kael fluidly advances through the crossfire, a blur of leaping
strikes and spinning green light trails carving through the dust. Resolve
climactic frame: Kael in a grounded low stance, sword sheathed, cowl blowing in
the wind, completely unbothered amidst fallen adversaries. High-velocity
whip-pans between beats; kinetic precision.

entries.prompt: STYLE: Handheld selfie vlog — arm's-length front camera, eyes locked to lens, natural micro-shake, bright airy festive tone. One continuous handheld take (no hard cuts); keep the young woman's face perfectly consistent across all shots, same happi robe/hair/smile/makeup. ~8s total. Aspect 9:16 vertical UGC. Color: warm golden sunset glow from festival lighting, lifted shadows, soft skin bloom from paper lanterns, energetic red-orange festival mood. Camera energy stays casual, intimate, and celebratory throughout. === (1) SHOT-BY-SHOT EFFECTS TIMELINE === SHOT 1 (00:00-00:02) — ARM'S-LENGTH FESTIVAL HELLO • EFFECT: handheld motion blur (subtle) + speed ramp (decel into eye-contact) • VISUAL: Young woman's face fills frame at arm's length in the bustling summer festival setting, wearing a bright red-white happi robe and festival headpiece, catching the lens with an energetic open-mouthed laugh; warm golden paper lantern glow and blurred festival crowd bokeh in the soft-focus background. • CAMERA: high-ish front-facing selfie angle (~10-15° down), handheld with organic micro-shake mimicking the movement of the mikoshi (portable shrine) swaying beneath, ~24mm wide phone-style lens, subtle push-in as the arm draws the phone closer. • SPEED: opens ~110% then decelerates to 100% as eyes settle on lens. • TRANSITION: natural handheld drift as the phone tilts down into Shot 2 (no cut). SHOT 2 (00:02-00:04) — JAPANESE CHANT BEAT (SIGNATURE) • EFFECT: SIGNATURE VISUAL EFFECT — intimate handheld eye-contact talk with live lip-sync to Japanese chanting, stacked with breathing rack focus (festival crowd softens into bokeh) + gentle golden ambient bloom from surrounding lanterns. • VISUAL: Woman's face speaks in Japanese: "わっしょい！わっしょい！" ("Wassoi! Wassoi!") with accurate lip-sync to the traditional festival cry, beaming smile, authentic celebratory energy; natural hand gestures (raising fist in festival rhythm) enter frame edge. • CAMERA: chest-up selfie framing in the heart of the festival, ~26mm, constant micro-jitter matching the rhythmic sway of the mikoshi; soft reframe to recenter the face; rack focus pulls the festival crowd and lanterns into creamy bokeh, keeping the face crisp. • SPEED: 100% real-time for honest lip-sync. • TRANSITION: quick handheld whip as the phone swings down to reveal the mikoshi action (motion-blur smear, no cut). SHOT 3 (00:04-00:06) — SHOW-AND-TELL (MIKOSHI & FESTIVAL) • EFFECT: digital zoom (scale-in ~115%) + motion blur + warm light leak from festival lanterns streaking the frame • VISUAL: Phone swings down to show the ornate wooden mikoshi (portable shrine) on the woman's shoulders, intricately carved gold details and crimson drapes catching lamplight; thick festival crowd in happi robes surround her, chanting and dancing; festival stalls with yatai (food carts) and red paper lanterns (chochin) strung overhead glow in the background; waves of heat shimmer rise from the throng; energetic, hot summer-festival atmosphere peaks here. • CAMERA: arm extends to capture the full scene, brief pull-back then digital push-in onto the mikoshi's decorative details and the swaying crowd, ~24mm, lively handheld sway; strong rhythmic shake on the downward swing matching the "wassoi" cadence. • SPEED: micro speed ramp — accel on the swing, settle to 100% on the reveal of the mikoshi. • TRANSITION: phone arcs back up to face on a quick handheld pan (motion blur), no cut. SHOT 4 (00:06-00:08) — CELEBRATION SIGN-OFF • EFFECT: speed ramp (decel) + soft golden bloom + slow-motion accent (~25%) on a final laugh and wave • VISUAL: Back to the woman's face front-on, flushed from exertion and joy, genuine beaming smile, casual celebratory wave toward lens; golden festival glow enveloping the frame, soft bloom on highlights from the sea of lanterns and crowd energy; warm, joyful, unmistakably festival UGC mood resolved. • CAMERA: chest-up selfie, ~26mm, micro-shake easing down as the chanting swells, the tiniest pull-back to give air around the face. • SPEED: ramps down into a ~25% slow-motion held beat on the final wave and radiant smile. • TRANSITION: settle and gentle golden bokeh hold to end (no cut). === (2) MASTER EFFECTS INVENTORY === 1. Handheld micro-shake / motion blur — used 4x (Shots 1,2,3,4) — the constant casual UGC texture, enhanced by mikoshi rhythmic sway. 2. Speed ramp (accel/decel) — used 3x (Shots 1,3,4) — energizes the festival opening, peaks on the mikoshi reveal, and eases the celebratory sign-off. 3. Rack focus / breathing bokeh — used 1x (Shot 2) — SIGNATURE; isolates the woman's joyful face during the intimate Japanese chant beat, softening the crowd. 4. Live lip-sync talk beat (Japanese) — used 1x (Shot 2) — anchors authenticity ("わっしょい！わっしょい！" with accurate sync to traditional festival rhythm). 5. Digital zoom (scale-in/push-in & pull-back) — used 3x (Shots 1,3,4) — draws viewer toward face, then to mikoshi details and crowd, back to face. 6. Warm light leak / festival lantern flare — used 1x (Shot 3) — golden-orange paper-lantern sparkle from chochin and ambient glow on the high-energy show-and-tell swing. 7. Whip pan (handheld smear) — used 2x (Shots 2→3, 3→4) — cutless bridges between face chant and mikoshi reveal, maintaining handheld continuity. 8. Soft bloom / golden highlight glow — used 4x (all shots) — warm festival lantern-lit evening signature tone throughout. 9. Slow-motion accent (~25%) — used 1x (Shot 4) — savors the final celebratory wave and triumphant smile. === (3) EFFECTS DENSITY MAP === • 00:00-00:02 (Shot 1) — MEDIUM DENSITY: handheld blur + decel ramp + push-in + warm golden bloom establish the festive selfie feel without overload; festival chants audible in the background. • 00:02-00:04 (Shot 2) — LOW DENSITY: deliberately intimate for the SIGNATURE Japanese chant beat — only rack focus + golden bloom over the lip-sync, letting the traditional "wassoi" cry and genuine joy carry. • 00:04-00:06 (Shot 3) — HIGH DENSITY: digital zoom + motion blur + warm light leak + whip-pan swing + crowd energy stacked for the peak festive show-and-tell reveal of the intricately carved wooden mikoshi with crimson drapes and glowing chochin lanterns surrounding the celebrating throng. • 00:06-00:08 (Shot 4) — MEDIUM-to-LOW DENSITY: decel ramp resolves into a ~25% slow-mo golden-bloom-soaked celebratory sign-off, winding the peak energy into a warm held smile. === (4) ENERGY ARC === • ACT 1 — HOOK (00:00-00:02): immediate arm's-length eye-contact with the joyful woman's face in the bustling festival setting; warm push-in and a celebratory decel grab attention in the first second. • ACT 2 — DEVELOPMENT / SIGNATURE (00:02-00:06): intimate Japanese chant beat ("わっしょい！わっしょい！") with signature breathing rack focus and golden bokeh (low-density trust moment celebrating tradition), then a high-density whip-and-zoom reveal of the ornate wooden mikoshi on her shoulders draped in crimson, surrounded by cheering happi-robed festival-goers, glowing red chochin paper lanterns overhead, and yatai stalls — the contrast spike that captures the full festive heat and energy. • ACT 3 — RESOLVE (00:06-00:08): camera returns to the woman's beaming face, energy decelerates into a ~25% slow-motion golden-bloom-lit celebratory wave and held smile — warm, joyful, conclusive, and unmistakably authentic festival UGC; the arc fully resolves on a radiant, triumph-filled final frame bathed in festival lantern light.

STEP 1 box: cute watercolor-style illustration of fresh raw prawns with green scallions, ginger slices, garlic cloves, rock sugar crystals arranged nearby, hand-written ingredient list labels with quantities. STEP 2 box: small illustrations of dark soy sauce bottle, light soy sauce, cooking rice wine with hand-written labels. STEP 3 box: a wok/frying pan on a flame with glossy red-orange braised prawns sizzling in sauce, rising steam drawn as wispy lines. STEP 4 box: semi-photorealistic final plated dish of 6-8 beautiful braised whole prawns in rich sauce garnished with fresh scallion greens on a white plate. Decorative elements: small pressed flower and star stickers, doodle borders, warm yellow-amber color palette throughout. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 可爱的螺旋装订食谱手账插画，日系漫画/动漫手绘风格。背景：温暖奶油黄色复古网格笔记本纸张纹理，左侧和顶端可见金属螺旋装订环。页面上排列四个图示食谱步骤。顶部：大型装饰性手写中文菜名，暖棕橙色泡泡字体，小樱花涂鸦点缀。步骤一方框：可爱水彩风格的新鲜生虾插画，旁边配有葱段、姜片、蒜头、冰糖晶体，手写食材标签配用量。步骤二方框：深色酱油瓶、生抽、料酒的小插画，配手写标签。步骤三方框：火焰上的炒锅/平底锅，红橙色光泽油焖大虾在酱汁中滋滋作响，缭绕蒸汽以飘散线条绘出。步骤四方框：半写实风格最终摆盘成品——6-8只完整美丽的油焖大虾淋上浓郁酱汁，白色盘子上撒新鲜葱花点缀。装饰元素：小型压花与星形贴纸、涂鸦边框、全篇温暖黄琥珀色调。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 城市名称3D景观字体设计
entries.description: 将中文城市名称的每个汉字变成立体三维景观字——字的笔画由微缩城市地标和自然景观构成：亭…
entries.prompt: Spectacular 3D Chinese character landscape typography art. The two characters for a Chinese city name are rendered as large-scale 3D sculptural forms, each character's strokes built from miniature city landmarks embedded within them. The brush strokes appear to be made of clay or thick paint, vibrant teal-blue color, with miniature 3D scenes growing from the strokes: classical stone arch bridges spanning the horizontal strokes, traditional Chinese pavilions and pagodas rising from the vertical strokes, weeping willow trees and blooming sakura/maple trees tucked into corners, lakes and rivers flowing through the curved strokes, traditional Chinese rooftop tiles visible on buildings. Bottom character has a multi-storied pagoda rising prominently from it, surrounded by a lake, stone lanterns, and autumn foliage in orange and red. Color palette: vibrant teal-cyan for the main strokes, red-orange pavilions, lush green trees, autumn orange and pink foliage. Pure white clean background. Small traditional red circular seal stamp (印章) in top right corner. Cinematic volumetric lighting. 9:16 vertical poster.
entries.promptZh: 震撼的三维中文城市名景观字体艺术。城市名称的每个汉字被渲染为大型三维雕塑形态，每个字的笔画由嵌入其中的城市地标微缩景观构成。笔画看起来由粘土或厚重颜料制成，鲜艳蓝绿色，微型三维场景从笔画中生长：经典石拱桥横跨横画，传统中国凉亭和宝塔从竖画中升起，垂柳和盛开的樱花/枫树嵌于笔画转折，湖泊和河流流淌于弧形笔画中，建筑上可见传统中式屋顶瓦片。下方汉字有多层宝塔从中突出，周围环绕湖泊、石灯笼、橙红秋色。色调：主笔画为鲜艳蓝绿色，红橙色亭台，翠绿树木，橙粉秋叶。纯白干净背景。右上角小型传统红色圆形印章。电影级体积光照。竖版9:16海报。

entries.title: 现代都市女性茶室人像
entries.description: 中西交融人像摄影：都市女性坐于仿古圈椅中，手捧透明茶杯，佩戴Apple Watch和有…
entries.prompt: Cinematic portrait of a modern Chinese woman in a traditional Chinese study-room setting. She sits relaxed in a classic rosewood circular armchair. Short wavy black hair, natural makeup, warm confident smile. Wearing an oversized brown wool sweater, Apple Watch on wrist, white wired earphones. Holding a glass tea cup with hot tea, visible steam rising. Background: classical Chinese wooden bookshelves lined with old books, decorative antiques, traditional lattice window with bamboo shadow outside. Warm golden amber cinematic light streaming from the window side. Color grade: warm browns, deep shadows, cozy afternoon mood. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 电影感人像摄影：现代都市中国女性坐于传统中式书房。她悠然坐在经典红木圈椅上。短卷发，淡妆，温暖自信的笑容。身穿咖啡色宽松羊毛毛衣，手腕佩戴Apple Watch，白色有线耳机挂于耳边。双手捧着透明玻璃茶杯，热茶升腾白色烟雾。背景：古典中式博古架陈列旧书与古玩，传统中式格窗，窗外竹影婆娑。暖金色电影光线从窗侧洒入。色调：暖棕色调，深沉阴影，午后慵懒氛围。85mm f/1.4拍摄，浅景深。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 中国省份三维地形可视化地图
entries.description: 三维立体地形省份地图：真实山脉起伏的地形地貌，每个地级市用不同颜色区块划分，省界及沿海…
entries.prompt: Photorealistic 3D topographic relief map of a Chinese province. The terrain is raised and sculpted showing actual mountain ranges, plains, and coastline geography in physical 3D relief. Each prefecture-level city region is filled with a distinct solid color: rich jewel tones — deep purple, warm orange-red, teal green, olive gold, dark amber, dusty blue, coral pink, sage green, warm slate. The outer border of the entire province and major river boundaries glow with electric neon blue light, as if lit from below. White bold Chinese city name labels float above each region. The province floats on a dark charcoal grey stone-textured base map showing surrounding geography (sea, neighboring provinces in grey). Dramatic cinematic lighting from upper left creating strong shadows on the raised terrain. Slightly aerial bird's-eye view angle. Ultra-realistic CGI render quality. 1:1 square.
entries.promptZh: 中国省份超写实三维地形起伏地图。地形凸起雕刻，真实呈现山脉、平原和海岸线地理的三维立体效果。每个地级市行政区划以不同纯色填充：丰富的宝石色调——深紫、暖橙红、蓝绿、橄榄金、深琥珀、雾蓝、珊瑚粉、鼠尾草绿、暖石板灰。整个省份外缘及主要河流边界发出电蓝色霓虹光，如同从下方照亮。白色粗体中文城市名称标签悬浮于各区域上方。省份漂浮在深炭灰色石质纹理底图上，显示周边地理（大海、邻省以灰色呈现）。左上方戏剧性电影光照，在凸起地形上制造强烈阴影。轻微航拍俯视角度。超写实CGI渲染品质。方版1:1。

entries.title: 范曾风格水墨人物肖像
entries.description: 范曾大师风格的中国写意水墨人物：古代文人/武将半身像，自信的大笔触勾勒五官，极简色彩—…
entries.prompt: Chinese ink wash portrait in the style of master Fan Zeng (范曾). Half-body portrait of an ancient Chinese scholar literati. Confident bold brushwork defining facial features — sharp eyebrows, knowing expression, goatee. Very limited color palette: rich black ink for hair and details, cobalt blue wash for robes, vermilion-red accent on earlobes and lips. Vast white paper background as negative space. Traditional topknot hairstyle with headband. Ink robes loosely rendered with wet brush strokes — not tight or detailed. Artist red seal stamp (印章) and calligraphy signature lower right corner. The proud scholarly spirit of Tang and Song dynasty literati. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以范曾大师风格创作的中国写意水墨人物肖像。古代中国【文人/武将/侠客/士大夫】半身像。自信有力的大笔触勾勒面部特征——锋利眉毛、深邃眼神、山羊胡。极简色彩：浓黑墨描绘头发与细节，钴蓝色晕染衣袍，朱砂红点染耳垂与嘴唇。大面积白色纸张背景作为留白。传统发髻造型配头巾束发。衣袍以湿润笔触松散表现——不拘谨、不精细。右下角有红色印章与书法落款。唐宋文人士大夫的傲骨与儒雅气质。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 中国古建筑爆炸结构图
entries.description: 中国古典建筑（故宫、天坛等）的爆炸分解结构图：中央为高精度3D等距渲染模型，屋顶/斗拱…
entries.prompt: Chinese imperial architecture exploded diagram infographic. Central subject: a Forbidden City main ceremonial hall (Taihedian) rendered as a highly detailed photorealistic isometric 3D model. Exploded view showing structural layers floating apart: glazed tile roof, elaborate dougong bracket clusters, red lacquer columns, painted ceiling medallion, marble terrace with balusters. White background. Technical blueprint drawings in corners: floor plan, elevation, cross-section. Chinese annotation lines with measurements pointing to architectural components. Gold, vermilion red, and deep teal color palette. JY DESIGN aesthetic — architecture education meets visual art. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 中国皇家建筑爆炸分解图信息图。中心主体：【建筑类型，如故宫楼阁/天坛/宝塔】以高度精细的写实等距3D模型呈现。爆炸视图展示各结构层漂浮分离：琉璃瓦屋顶、精美斗拱组、朱红漆柱、彩绘藻井、汉白玉栏杆台基。白色背景。角落有技术蓝图：平面图、立面图、剖面图。带尺寸标注的中文引线指向各建筑构件。金色、朱红与深青的色调搭配。JY DESIGN美学——建筑教育与视觉艺术的融合。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: Quentin Blake 手绘卡通插画
entries.description: 模仿罗尔德·达尔御用插画师 Quentin Blake 的经典风格：奔放的钢笔线条、蜡…
entries.prompt: Create an illustration in the exact style of Quentin Blake, the beloved illustrator of Roald Dahl books. Loose, energetic ink line work with slightly scratchy pen strokes. Watercolor and crayon washes as fill — never perfectly within the lines. Two expressive cartoon characters interacting: a wild-haired absent-minded professor and a delighted gap-toothed child in a chaotic garden with books flying everywhere. Exaggerated facial expressions and gestural body language. Wildflowers, garden plants, or simple interior props as background. Off-white or cream paper background. Playful hand-lettered style title if text needed. The spontaneous, joyful energy of classic British children's book illustration. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以 Quentin Blake（罗尔德·达尔御用插画师）的经典风格创作插画。松散而充满活力的钢笔线条，略带抖动感的笔触。水彩与蜡笔填色，颜色不需要精准在线条内。两个表情夸张的卡通人物互动：【角色1】与【角色2】在【场景/背景】中。夸大的表情与肢体语言充满表现力。背景用野花、花园植物或简单室内道具。米白色或奶油色纸张背景。如有文字则使用手写感的俏皮字体。捕捉经典英国童书插画那种自发的、欢乐的生命力。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 汉服时尚编辑大片
entries.description: 汉服时尚编辑大片，古代华服在自然山水间飘逸，传统服饰美学的当代时尚重新演绎。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful hanfu traditional Chinese clothing fashion editorial. Model in flowing silk hanfu — Wei or Tang dynasty style — in natural setting: bamboo grove, lotus pond, or ancient architecture. Fabric movement in wind. Natural light. Cultural poetry combined with fashion photography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的汉服中国传统服饰时尚编辑大片。模特穿着飘逸丝绸汉服——魏或唐朝风格——在自然场景中：竹林、荷花池或古建筑。面料在风中飘动。自然光线。文化诗意与时装摄影的结合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 传统服饰民族人像
entries.description: 传统民族服饰人像，精美刺绣与配饰记录文化的精华，人文与美学兼备的视觉档案。
entries.prompt: Create a dignified traditional costume portrait of Miao ethnic minority of Guizhou — elaborate silver headdress and embroidered costume. Subject wearing authentic traditional garments with intricate embroidery, jewelry, and headdress. Natural light or softbox that honors the textile details. Respectful documentary photography. Rich textile texture visible. Cultural heritage documentation quality. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[民族/文化]】庄重的传统服饰人像。人物穿着真实的传统服装，配有精美刺绣、珠宝与头饰。尊重纺织细节的自然光或柔光箱。尊重文化的纪录式摄影。丰富织物质感可见。文化遗产记录品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 浮世绘现代融合插画
entries.description: 浮世绘与现代元素的视觉融合，传统木版印刷风格描绘当代都市场景，古今对话。
entries.prompt: Create a Ukiyo-e style woodblock print illustration fusing traditional with modern: classic Hokusai or Hiroshige style but depicting a vintage red Ferrari 250 GTO racing through rain. Hand-carved woodblock print texture. Limited palette with flat areas. Bold black outlines. Diagonal rain or wave pattern. Poetic fusion of eras. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作浮世绘风格木版印刷插画，融合传统与现代：经典北斋或广重风格，但描绘【[现代主题——东京天际线、跑车、宇航员]】。手雕木版印刷质感。有限色板与平面色块区域。粗犷黑色轮廓线。斜线雨或波浪纹样。跨越时代的诗意融合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 史诗龙骑士动漫
entries.description: 史诗龙骑士动漫大片，骑士与神龙翱翔于云层之上，壮阔天空与神话级别的视觉震撼。
entries.prompt: Create an epic dragon rider anime illustration. A heroic anime warrior riding a magnificent dragon soaring above dramatic cloud formations. The dragon has detailed scales and powerful wings spread wide. Blazing sunset or dramatic stormy sky background. Motion and speed implied by cloud streaks. Epic fantasy anime movie poster quality — inspired by Dragon Ball, Made in Abyss level of artistic detail. Cinematic widescreen 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张史诗龙骑士动漫插画。英雄动漫战士骑乘壮观神龙翱翔于戏剧性云层之上。神龙拥有细节满满的鳞片和大力展开的巨翼。背景是燃烧般落日或戏剧性风暴天空。云迹暗示运动与速度。史诗奇幻动漫电影海报品质——受七龙珠、来自深渊的艺术细节水准启发。电影感宽银幕 16:9。

entries.title: 樱花小巷
entries.description: 日本樱花小巷，粉色花瓣漫天飞舞，古老石板路通向诗意的远方，春天最美的邀请。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking cherry blossom alley photograph in Japan. A narrow stone-paved path flanked by ancient cherry trees in full bloom — thick overarching branches creating a pink floral tunnel. Fallen petals covering the ground and floating in the air. Soft spring morning light filtering through blossoms. Possibly a traditional gate or lantern in background. Film photography aesthetic with Kodak Portra colors. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张日本令人叹息的樱花小巷照片。狭窄石板路两侧是盛开的古老樱树，茂密的樱花枝条拱成粉色花隧道。凋落花瓣铺满地面并飘浮在空气中。柔和的春日晨光从花丛中过滤而下。背景可见传统门廊或灯笼。胶片摄影美学，Kodak Portra 色调。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 三维卡通角色
entries.description: 极致夸张比例的 3D CGI 卡通头像，超柔和哑光材质，饱和渐变背景强烈视觉对比，漫画…
entries.prompt: Extreme 3D CGI cartoon of {argument name="character" default="a chubby corgi puppy wearing a tiny golden crown"} extremely exaggerated proportions and oversized features for maximum comic effect. Head and shoulders portrait photo, incredibly styled with bold and dramatic expressions. Ultra soft matte materials. Character perspective. Saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange gradient"} background that creates a strong visual contrast. Soft lighting and ambient shadows for depth.
entries.promptZh: 极致的 3D CGI 卡通形象，【{argument name="character" default="[角色]"} 】具有极度夸张的比例和超大特征，以达到最佳漫画效果。头部和肩部肖像摄影，以大胆戏剧性的表情进行极具风格化的处理。超柔和的哑光材质。角色视角。饱和的【{argument name="background color" default="橙色渐变"}】背景，营造强烈视觉对比。柔和灯光和环境阴影增加深度感。

entries.title: 柯达 Portra 杂志风人像
entries.description: Kodak Portra 400 胶片的招牌调色——奶白高光、提亮暗部、肤色精准还原、…
entries.prompt:
Create a fashion editorial portrait of a young East Asian woman with natural wavy hair shot on Kodak Portra 400 film. Location: golden hour rooftop with city skyline. The model is styled in relaxed chic.

Film characteristics: Portra 400's signature milky highlights with slight halation, lifted shadows revealing shadow detail, accurate warm skin tone reproduction, gentle grain structure visible at 100%. Greens are slightly desaturated shifting toward olive. Blues remain cool and crisp.

Lighting: available natural light as primary source, possibly supplemented with white reflector for fill. The light should feel effortless and unmanipulated. Lens: 85mm portrait equivalent, f/2 shallow depth of field, buttery background bokeh. Slightly underexposed ⅓ stop for richer tones.

Mood: sophisticated, unhurried, the photograph feels found rather than made. Slight organic imperfection—a small breath blur, the model mid-blink or mid-laugh. Magazine quality but with soul. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅在柯达Portra 400胶片上拍摄的【[主角]】时尚编辑人像。地点：【[场景：黄金时刻屋顶/自然窗光摄影棚/地中海街道]】。模特造型为【[风格：休闲优雅/编辑先锋]】。

胶片特性：Portra 400标志性的奶白高光带轻微光晕，提亮暗部展现细节，精准的暖肤色还原，100%放大时可见柔和颗粒结构。绿色略微去饱和向橄榄色偏移。蓝色保持冷峻清晰。

光效：可用自然光作为主光源，可能以白色反光板补光。光线应感觉毫不费力和未经处理。镜头：85mm等效焦段，f/2浅景深，黄油般的背景虚化。轻微欠曝⅓档以获得更丰富的色调。

氛围：精致、从容，照片感觉是被发现而非被制作。轻微有机不完美——轻微的呼吸模糊，模特半眨眼或大笑中。杂志品质但有灵魂。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 奢华护肤品广告大片
entries.description: 高端护肤品广告的极致美学——黑暗背景、戏剧光影、液体飞溅与产品的完美邂逅。
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic luxury skincare product advertisement for LUMIÈRE Sérum Éclat. Dark studio background fading to absolute black. The product—an elegant glass bottle or jar—sits as the primary hero, lit with dramatic single-source lighting that creates sharp specular highlights and deep, rich shadows.

Surround the product with a dynamic frozen-moment splash: translucent serum or water erupting upward, droplets suspended mid-air, catching the light as perfect spheres. Floating botanical elements—white orchid petals, gold leaf fragments, or fresh herb sprigs—orbit the scene at varying distances.

Texture emphasis: cold glass clarity, liquid surface tension, velvet matte packaging. Color palette: deep charcoal black, warm champagne gold, pure white light. One accent color from the brand (rose, jade, or midnight blue). Photorealistic commercial photography quality, 4K. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh:
为【[产品名称]】创作一幅电影级奢华护肤品广告。暗色摄影棚背景渐变至纯黑。产品——一个优雅的玻璃瓶或罐——作为主角，以戏剧性的单光源照明，产生锐利的高光和深沉丰富的阴影。

用动态凝固瞬间包围产品：半透明精华液或水向上迸发，水珠悬停在空中，捕捉光线如完美球体。飘浮的植物元素——白色兰花花瓣、金箔碎片或新鲜香草嫩芽——在不同距离环绕场景。

质感重点：冰冷玻璃的清澈感、液体表面张力、哑光天鹅绒包装。色彩：深炭灰黑、暖香槟金、纯白光。加入一个品牌强调色（玫瑰、翡翠绿或午夜蓝）。摄影级真实感商业大片，4K。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 怀旧胶片拼贴摄影
entries.description: 70-80年代复古胶片美学，多张叠加的旧照片、手写文字、邮票和胶带，构成有故事感的拼贴…
entries.prompt:
Create a retro film collage photograph featuring a young woman wandering through 1970s Tokyo. Layer multiple vintage photographs of different sizes, angles, and ages—some faded, some over-exposed, some with light leaks and film grain. The main subject should emerge from this layered composition.

Intersperse physical ephemera: Polaroid frames, yellowed newspaper clippings, airmail envelopes, dried flowers pressed flat, vintage stamps, old ticket stubs, washi tape strips in muted earth tones. Add handwritten annotations in pencil and faded blue ink—dates, captions, fragments of poetry.

Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 warmth—milky highlights, lifted blacks, soft grain, desaturated greens pushing toward olive. Slight vignette at corners. The overall mood evokes memory, nostalgia, and the material weight of preserved moments. Aspect ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[主题]】为核心的复古胶片拼贴摄影作品。叠加多张不同尺寸、角度和年代的老照片——有些褪色、有些过曝、有些带有漏光和胶片颗粒。主体从这种层叠构图中浮现。

穿插实物纸制品：宝丽来相框、泛黄的报纸剪报、航空邮件信封、压平的干花、复古邮票、旧车票票根、和纸胶带（土地色调）。用铅笔和褪色蓝墨水添加手写注释——日期、说明文字、诗歌片段。

色彩调色：柯达Portra 400的温暖感——奶白高光、提亮的暗部、柔和颗粒、去饱和的绿色推向橄榄色。角落轻微暗角。整体氛围唤起记忆、怀旧和珍藏瞬间的物质重量。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 极简线描女孩与红花插画
entries.description: 极简钢笔线描少女侧影，低胸露背长裙随风飘逸，手持一枝盛开的红色罂粟花，纯白背景大量留白…
entries.prompt: Extremely minimalist fine line art illustration, a young woman shown in full-body side silhouette profile, hair pulled back into a loose low bun with wispy strands, a calm serene expression, wearing a long flowing high-neck dress with long sleeves, the dress fabric rendered in loose flowing pen lines suggesting movement in a breeze, delicate flat sandals. She holds a single stem of blooming red poppy flowers with several open blossoms and buds down at her side, rendered in vivid red and green watercolor coloring as the only colored elements in the entire illustration. The rest of the figure and dress are pure black fine-line pen drawing on a completely blank white background with no other elements. Extremely elegant negative space composition, delicate confident linework, minimalist fashion illustration aesthetic, 1:2 tall vertical
entries.promptZh: 极其简约的精细线描插画，一位年轻女性以全身侧面剪影呈现，头发向后梳成松散的低丸子头带碎发丝，表情宁静平和，身穿飘逸的高领长袖长裙，裙摆面料以松散流动的钢笔线条表现随风飘动感，精致的平底凉鞋。她手持一枝盛开的红色罂粟花垂在身侧，几朵盛开花朵和花苞，以鲜艳的红绿水彩上色作为整幅插画中唯一的彩色元素。人物其余部分和裙装均为纯黑色钢笔线描，背景是完全空白的白色，没有其他元素。极其优雅的留白构图，精致自信的线条表现，极简时尚插画美学，1:2瘦长竖版

entries.title: 日系大妈角色表情包贴纸组

entries.prompt: Cheerful cartoon sticker pack illustration, a 3×4 grid of twelve individual stickers all featuring the same recurring character: a middle-aged Japanese woman with a permed curly brown updo hairstyle, round glasses (in some panels), wearing a leopard-print cardigan and colorful floral outfits, exaggerated comedic facial expressions and body language in each panel matching a different everyday emotion or situation. Each sticker shows the character in a distinct pose: giving an enthusiastic thumbs up, panicking dramatically over a boiling pot on the stove, cheering with a fist pump, doing a confident thumbs up while holding a notebook, waving cheerfully while shopping, jogging energetically in a tracksuit, sitting exhausted looking sad, fanning herself dramatically looking overheated, gesturing gracefully with a flowing motion, sipping tea contentedly from a teapot, pointing firmly at a moving box, clasping hands together with a delighted sparkly expression. Each sticker has a large bold colorful Japanese text word or phrase in a speech-bubble-adjacent comic font positioned above or beside the character matching her expression (like "well done", "oh no", "here we go", "nice", "next", "one more round", "it's over", "too hot", "good flow", "reset", "put it there", "wonderful"), each text outlined with a thick white border for sticker readability. Clean white background behind each character, vibrant flat cartoon coloring, thick black outline character design, LINE messaging app sticker pack aesthetic, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 欢快的卡通表情贴纸包插画，3×4网格排列十二张独立贴纸，全部以同一位反复出现的角色为主角：一位中年日本女性，烫染卷曲棕色盘发，圆框眼镜（部分格子出现），身穿豹纹开衫和缤纷花色服装，每格都用夸张的喜剧化面部表情和肢体语言演绎不同的日常情绪或场景。每张贴纸展示角色不同姿态：热情竖大拇指、对着炉灶上沸腾的锅戏剧性地惊慌、握拳欢呼庆祝、拿着笔记本自信竖大拇指、开心挥手购物、穿运动服精神抖擞地慢跑、疲惫地坐着显得难过、戏剧性地扇风显得燥热、优雅地做流动手势、心满意足地喝茶、坚定地指向一个移动纸箱、双手合十露出闪亮的欣喜表情。每张贴纸都配一个大号粗体彩色日文单词或短语，以类似对话框的漫画字体排布在角色上方或旁边，与她的表情相配（如"做得好"、"糟糕"、"来吧"、"真棒"、"下一个"、"再来一轮"、"结束了"、"太热了"、"节奏不错"、"重置"、"放这里"、"太棒了"），每段文字都描边加粗白色边框以便贴纸辨识。每个角色背后是干净的白色背景，鲜艳的扁平卡通上色，粗黑色轮廓角色设计，LINE聊天软件贴纸包美学，4:5竖版

entries.title: 巴黎街头OOTD拍立得穿搭标注
entries.description: 巴黎街头咖啡桌上放着一张拍立得照片，照片中女生穿驼色高领毛衣配短裙长靴俏皮跳跃，白色手…
entries.prompt: Creative OOTD fashion photograph with a photo-within-photo concept. A round wooden outdoor cafe table with scattered golden autumn maple leaves and a ceramic cup of coffee on a saucer, set on a Parisian sidewalk with a blurred cafe storefront and street visible in the background. Resting on the table is a large polaroid-style instant photograph with a white border, and within that polaroid photograph, a three-dimensional effect makes it appear as if a young woman is physically emerging out of the photograph into the real world: her head, torso, and upper body extend above the polaroid's surface in full photorealistic 3D form, wearing a beige ribbed turtleneck sweater and matching beige mini skirt, while her legs in tall brown leather knee-high boots remain flat within the 2D polaroid image below, creating a playful dimensional break effect. She leans forward with a playful pouty expression, one hand reaching toward the camera. White handwritten-style annotation text with thin arrows point to her boots labeled "leather boots", her skirt labeled "mini skirt", and her sweater labeled "clean turtleneck". Small text at the bottom of the polaroid reads "OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS". Warm autumn afternoon lighting, realistic street photography aesthetic merged with creative dimensional photo-manipulation, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 创意的OOTD穿搭摄影，照片中有照片的概念设计。一张圆形木质户外咖啡桌，散落着金黄色秋季枫叶和一杯配茶碟的陶瓷咖啡，置于巴黎人行道上，背景是虚化的咖啡馆橱窗和街道。桌上放着一张带白边的大号拍立得风格即时照片，照片内运用立体效果，让人感觉一位年轻女性正从照片中实际探出身体进入现实世界：她的头部、躯干和上半身以完整的照片级3D形态延伸到拍立得表面之上，穿着米色罗纹高领毛衣配同色系米色迷你裙，而她穿着高筒棕色皮质及膝靴的双腿则仍平面呈现在下方2D拍立得图像内，营造俏皮的维度突破效果。她身体前倾露出俏皮的嘟嘴表情，一手伸向镜头。白色手写风格标注文字配细箭头指向她的靴子标注"leather boots"，裙子标注"mini skirt"，毛衣标注"clean turtleneck"。拍立得底部小字写着"OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS"。温暖的秋日午后光线，写实街拍摄影美学融合创意维度照片合成，4:5竖版

entries.title: 复古乡村校园操场纪实摄影
entries.description: 八九十年代红砖平房教室外的乡村小学操场，孩子们蓝布校服嬉戏打闹，篮球架黑板报与标语墙唤…
entries.prompt: Nostalgic documentary-style photograph of a rural Chinese elementary school courtyard from the 1980s-1990s era. A long red-brick single-story school building with a grey tiled roof and multiple wood-framed windows, faded red painted Chinese slogan characters on the brick wall reading an encouraging educational phrase, a small blackboard mounted outside one classroom door showing simple handwritten arithmetic. A weathered basketball hoop with a worn wooden backboard and a metal rim with an old net stands in the dirt courtyard, a loudspeaker mounted on a wooden pole nearby. Several children in matching worn blue denim-style school uniforms with canvas satchel bags play and walk around the dusty courtyard in various small groups, some sitting on a low wall, some walking with backpacks, captured in candid unposed documentary moments. Bare young trees with sparse leaves planted in a row, tall trees with green foliage in the background. Warm hazy golden-hour sunlight, soft warm color grading with slight film grain texture reminiscent of vintage Kodak film photography, nostalgic collective memory mood, authentic 1990s Chinese rural school aesthetic, 9:16 vertical
entries.promptZh: 怀旧纪实风格摄影，展现1980-1990年代中国乡村小学操场。一栋长长的红砖平房教室，灰色瓦顶配多扇木框窗户，砖墙上褪色的红漆中文标语写着励志教育短语，一间教室门外挂着小黑板，上面是简单的手写算术题。泥土操场上立着一个风化的篮球架，木质篮板已磨损，铁圈上挂着旧网，附近木杆上装着一个广播喇叭。几个孩子穿着统一的做旧蓝色牛仔布校服，背着帆布书包，三三两两地在尘土操场上玩耍走动，有的坐在矮墙上，有的背着书包行走，捕捉到自然随性的纪实瞬间。稀疏树叶的光秃小树成排种植，背景是枝叶茂盛的高大树木。温暖朦胧的黄金时刻阳光，柔和暖色调配轻微胶片颗粒质感，怀旧的集体记忆氛围，真实的1990年代中国乡村校园美学，9:16竖版

entries.title: 明星时尚杂志封面拼贴图
entries.description: 同一位女明星身着米色针织衫牛仔裙的九宫格杂志封面拼贴，Vogue、Bazaar、ELL…
entries.prompt: Fan-made celebrity magazine cover collage poster, a 3×3 grid layout with the center panel larger than the surrounding eight panels. Center: a full-body photograph of a young Asian female celebrity with long straight black hair, standing confidently, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater tucked loosely into a light-wash denim mini skirt, white knee-high socks, white sneakers, one hand in pocket. Surrounding panels each show a different cropped photograph of the same woman (close-up of her eyes, laughing candidly, side profile portrait, sitting on a wooden stool, hands framing her face smiling, three-quarter body shot) styled as different fashion magazine covers, each panel bearing a different famous magazine masthead logo in the top area (Vogue, Elle, Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, i-D) rendered in each magazine's signature typography style, with small mock article headline text scattered around each cover mimicking real magazine cover text placement, a small barcode graphic in one bottom corner. Neutral cream and beige color palette throughout matching her outfit, high-fashion editorial photography quality, glossy magazine cover aesthetic, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 粉丝制作风格的明星杂志封面拼贴海报，3×3网格排版，中央格子比周围八格更大。中央：一位长直黑发的年轻亚裔女明星全身照，自信站立，穿oversize奶油色绞花针织毛衣松垮地塞进浅色水洗牛仔迷你裙，白色及膝袜，白色运动鞋，一手插兜。周围格子各展示同一女性的不同裁切照片（眼部特写、率真大笑、侧脸肖像、坐在木凳上、双手托脸微笑、四分之三身照），呈现为不同的时尚杂志封面样式，每格顶部区域带有不同的知名杂志刊头logo（Vogue、Elle、Harper's Bazaar、Marie Claire、i-D），以各杂志标志性字体风格呈现，每个封面周围散布着模拟真实杂志封面排版的小号仿文章标题文字，一个底角配小号条形码图形。整体呈现与她服装相配的中性奶油米色调，高级时尚编辑摄影品质，光泽感杂志封面美学，4:5竖版

entries.title: 米兰卡通贴纸旅行拼贴图
entries.description: 真人游客背影站在米兰大教堂前，周围环绕同一角色的卡通Q版贴纸重现拍照、骑摩托、吃披萨吃…
entries.prompt: Playful travel memory collage photograph, a real photograph of a young woman with long curly brown hair, black crop top and wide-leg jeans, standing with her back to the camera looking up at the grand Gothic facade of Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano) with its intricate spires and statues, warm overcast daylight. Surrounding this central real photograph, scattered around the composition, are seven small chibi-style cartoon sticker illustrations of the same curly-haired woman character in different cute poses relating to travel activities: waving an Italian flag excitedly, taking a photo with a camera, sitting at a cafe table with coffee and a croissant, riding a small green scooter, eating a large ice cream cone joyfully, reading a paper map looking adorably lost, sitting cross-legged eating a slice of pizza happily. Each chibi sticker has a thin white sticker border. Scattered hand-drawn doodle elements throughout: small pink hearts, sparkle stars, dashed motion lines. Handwritten casual script text captions near each sticker in white and pink (Ciao Milano, Milan you stole my heart, capturing beautiful memories, coffee and dreams, gelato makes everything better, la dolce vita, getting lost in the best way, pizza is always a good idea, grazie milano, not a dream just italy). Bottom right: a small torn-paper style note reading "Milan, Italy" with a checklist (eat well, wander more, fall in love, repeat) in handwritten font. Warm nostalgic photo color grading, Instagram travel story aesthetic, 9:16 vertical
entries.promptZh: 俏皮的旅行回忆拼贴摄影，一张真实照片展示一位长卷棕发的年轻女性，黑色短上衣配阔腿牛仔裤，背对镜头仰望米兰大教堂精美的哥特式立面，尖塔和雕像细节丰富，暖色阴天光线。这张中央真实照片周围散布着七个小巧的Q版卡通贴纸插画，都是同一位卷发女性角色在不同可爱的旅行活动姿势中：兴奋地挥舞意大利国旗、拿相机拍照、坐在咖啡馆桌旁享用咖啡和牛角包、骑一辆绿色小摩托车、开心地吃一个大冰淇淋筒、拿着纸质地图看起来可爱地迷路了、盘腿坐着开心地吃一片披萨。每个Q版贴纸都有细白色贴纸边框。画面散布着手绘涂鸦元素：小粉色爱心、闪亮星星、虚线运动线条。每个贴纸旁配白色和粉色手写随性字体文案（你好米兰、米兰偷走了我的心、捕捉美好回忆、咖啡与梦想、意式冰淇淋让一切更美好、甜蜜生活、以最好的方式迷路、披萨永远是个好主意、谢谢米兰、不是梦只是意大利）。右下角：一张撕纸风格的小便签写着"米兰，意大利"配手写字体清单（好好吃饭、多多闲逛、坠入爱河、重复以上）。温暖怀旧的照片调色，Instagram旅行故事美学，9:16竖版

entries.title: 苹果品牌人格漫画信息图
entries.description: 以史蒂夫·乔布斯为品牌拟人化形象的8格漫画信息图，展示品牌在不同场景下的沟通风格与情感…
entries.prompt: Bold branding strategy comic infographic poster, orange-and-black color scheme throughout. Top: large orange Apple logo icon and bold orange "Apple" wordmark, with bold black Chinese headline text asking what this brand feels like, an orange highlighted subtitle about quiet confidence and sharp boundaries. Center: a large realistic illustrated portrait of an older man resembling a tech visionary with round glasses, grey stubble beard, black turtleneck sweater, holding an orange smartphone in one hand and a black smartphone in the other, confident direct gaze, bold black banner text beneath him reading "I am Apple" with Chinese subtitle about the product not being the point but the experience being the point. Surrounding the central portrait: eight numbered comic-style panels arranged around the edges, each showing a small illustrated scene of the man in a different scenario (talking with a customer, facing a competitor, selling a product, social media presence, facing criticism, daily brand life, a product launch moment, interacting with the world), each panel labeled with a bold numbered Chinese title and containing small speech bubbles with brand-voice Chinese dialogue, small like and comment count icons on the social media panel. Bottom section: a "DO" and "DON'T" two-column checklist with small icon badges and Chinese labels for brand behaviors to embrace and avoid, plus a small personality trait radar chart graphic with Chinese labels, a row of small color swatch circles showing the brand's orange-black-cream color palette, and a closing quote attributed to Steve Jobs. Clean modern infographic poster design with comic panel illustration style, 2:3 vertical
entries.promptZh: 大胆的品牌策略漫画信息图海报，全篇橙黑配色。顶部：大号橙色苹果logo图标和粗体橙色"Apple"品牌字，配粗体黑色中文标题询问这个品牌的感觉是什么，橙色高亮副标题讲述安静的自信、锋利的边界。中央：一幅写实插画风格的年长男性肖像，形似科技远见者，圆框眼镜，灰色胡茬，黑色高领毛衣，一手拿橙色智能手机一手拿黑色智能手机，自信直视，下方粗体黑色横幅文字写着"我是Apple"，配中文副标题讲述产品不是重点，体验才是。中央肖像周围：八个编号漫画风格分格排布在边缘，每格展示该男性在不同场景中的小插画场景（与客户交流、面对竞争对手、销售产品、社交媒体表现、面对批评、日常品牌生活、发布新品时刻、与世界互动），每格标注粗体编号中文标题，内含带品牌语气中文对话的小对话框，社交媒体那格有小号点赞和评论数图标。底部区域：一个"DO"和"DON'T"双栏检查清单，配小图标徽章和中文标签列出应该拥抱和避免的品牌行为，加一个小号人格特征雷达图配中文标签，一排小圆形色卡展示品牌的橙黑奶油色配色方案，以及结尾处归于史蒂夫·乔布斯的引言。干净现代的信息图海报设计配漫画分格插画风格，2:3竖版

entries.description: 侧脸插画少女梳丸子头露碎发，佩戴流苏耳坠，穿高领毛衣外搭风衣，米色底纹背景配抽象枝叶图…
entries.prompt: Elegant vintage-style illustrated portrait, a young woman shown in three-quarter side profile, dark brown hair styled in a loose messy bun with wispy flyaway strands and blunt bangs partially covering one eye, a small beauty mark near her mouth, wearing a long dangling gold tassel earring, dressed in a black ribbed turtleneck sweater beneath an olive-brown draped coat, gazing downward with a calm distant expression. Rendered in expressive loose pen linework combined with soft watercolor wash coloring, visible ink line texture on the hair strands, subtle cream-beige aged paper background with a faded sage-green rectangular color block behind her shoulder containing a minimalist ink-line illustration of a blossoming branch with small round berries. Muted earthy color palette of browns, olive, and cream, nostalgic literary illustration aesthetic blending Japanese anime linework with vintage fine art sensibility, 4:5 vertical
entries.promptZh: 优雅的复古风格插画人像，一位年轻女性呈四分之三侧脸角度，深棕色头发梳成松散凌乱的丸子头带碎发丝，齐刘海遮住一只眼睛，嘴角附近有一颗美人痣，佩戴一只长垂坠金色流苏耳坠，身穿黑色罗纹高领毛衣外搭橄榄棕色垂坠风衣，低头凝视，表情平静而疏离。以富有表现力的松散钢笔线条结合柔和水彩晕染上色呈现，发丝上可见明显的墨线质感，柔和的米黄色做旧纸张背景，肩后有一块褪色鼠尾草绿矩形色块，内含极简墨线插画的开花枝条配小圆浆果。柔和大地色调的棕色、橄榄绿与米色，融合日系动漫线条与复古美术质感的怀旧文艺插画美学，4:5竖版

Center foreground: a cute cartoon girl backpacker with long brown hair, rosy cheeks, sunglasses pushed up on her head, wearing a grey hoodie with Korean text on the sleeve and black leggings, carrying a black backpack, looking back over her shoulder with a warm smile, rendered as a die-cut paper sticker with visible white paper edge outline and soft drop shadow giving genuine 3D papercraft depth. entries.prompt: Minimalist creative advertising concept photograph, deep solid royal blue background. A tired man wearing a white long-sleeve shirt slumps forward with his head down resting on his folded arms on an unseen surface, viewed from the side, dark skin, curly black hair. On his upper back, a glowing orange-yellow neon battery icon outline shows a low charge level with only two segments lit. A glowing orange-yellow neon cable line curves upward and to the right from the battery icon, connecting to the cap of a standing juice carton box. The juice carton is photographed realistically with visible condensation water droplets, labeled with a red-and-blue logo, blue "active" wordmark, text "power of 6" and "fortified with vitamin C", and a photograph of fresh orange and grapefruit slices on the lower part of the carton, "1Lt" volume label. entries.prompt: Professional character design reference sheet infographic, 16:9 wide format, clean white background with thin black divider lines organizing sections. Bold title "CHARACTER ESSENCE UNVEILED" top-left with subtitle "REALISTIC DECONSTRUCTION". Center: a full-body photograph of a young East Asian woman with long black hair kneeling in an elegant black mini dress, high heels, natural photographic lighting. Top-left section labeled "PRIVATE LIFE & PERSONAL ITEMS": a stack of vintage books, an open handwritten journal, a leather personal photo album with polaroid pictures, a folded blanket, a ceramic mug, small skincare bottles labeled "essential oils", a small potted plant, an eye sleep mask. Bottom-left section labeled "HOBBIES & INTERESTS": a sketchbook with pencil drawings, a violin, an artist paint palette with brushes, wireless headphones, a vintage film camera with lens, binoculars. Top-right section labeled "EXPRESSIONS & MOODS": six small square photo portraits of the same woman's face showing different expressions labeled CANDID, CONTEMPLATIVE, NATURAL, LAUGHING, BLUSHING, SLEEPING. Middle-right section labeled "FASHION & ATELIER": the black dress shown from front and back with construction detail callouts labeling fabric "100% SILK" and "LINING", plus black high heel shoes and delicate gold jewelry (necklace, rings). Bottom-right section labeled "BEAUTY & SELF-CARE": makeup compact, lipstick, perfume bottles, a cream jar, a hairbrush, makeup brushes. All sections connected to the center photo with thin diagonal guide lines, clean modern infographic design system, professional product-catalog photography style for each item, 16:9 horizontal

entries.prompt: Elegant Chinese-style minimalist illustration of the Great Wall winding through mountains at sunrise, 9:16 vertical format. A large glowing red-orange sun sits low on the horizon partially veiled by soft white clouds, sky gradient transitioning from warm peach at the top to soft cream white. Layered mountain ranges rendered in flowing gradient washes of deep crimson red and warm orange, with delicate golden line-art strokes tracing the contours and ridges of each mountain like flowing threads of light. The Great Wall itself is rendered as a glowing golden ribbon of light with visible crenellated battlements, winding in a dramatic S-curve from the upper mountains down through the misty white foreground, with two small golden watchtowers along its path. Fine golden particle sparkles and flowing line trails scatter along the wall and foreground like scattered gold dust on silk. Extensive soft white negative space in the foreground grounding the composition. Sophisticated blend of traditional Chinese ink-line art and modern gold-foil greeting card aesthetic, serene majestic mood, 9:16 vertical
entries.promptZh: 优雅的中式极简插画，长城蜿蜒穿行于日出山峦之间，9:16竖版。一轮硕大的红橙色朝阳低悬天际，被柔白云朵半遮，天空从上方的暖桃色渐变为柔和的米白色。层叠山峦以深红与暖橙色的流动渐变晕染表现，山脊轮廓用细腻的金色线条如流动的丝线般勾勒。长城本身呈现为发光的金色光带，可见清晰的城垛轮廓，以戏剧性的S形从上方山峦蜿蜒而下穿过朦胧的白色前景，沿途点缀两座小巧的金色烽火台。精细的金色粒子光斑和流线沿长城和前景散落，如金粉洒落绸缎。前景大面积柔白留白稳定构图。传统中国水墨线描艺术与现代烫金贺卡美学的精致融合，宁静壮阔的氛围，9:16竖版
